title.instructions: Use a concise, task-shaped title in imperative mood. Mention the affected feature when useful; omit issue numbers and trailing punctuation.

branchName.instructions: Use <type>/<short-kebab-case-description>. Prefer feat/ for new behavior, fix/ for bugs, docs/ for documentation, refactor/ for restructuring, test/ for tests, and chore/ for maintenance. Keep names short, lowercase, and descriptive.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits with a required lowercase scope: type(scope): imperative subject. Keep the subject concise, specific, and without a trailing period. Use feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, or build as appropriate.

pullRequest.instructions: Use a concise title matching the Conventional Commit style with a scope. Write the body with Summary and Testing sections; use short bullets, name the user-visible impact, list exact validation commands run, and include Risks or Follow-up only when relevant. Do not claim tests or behavior that were not verified.
